title: Implement Email+Password + OTP login (replace placeholders) and ensure Admin redirect

requirements.text: Implement backend Email+Password authentication APIs in the single Motoko actor so a user can authenticate with email and password, and the backend can assign roles based on the authenticated identity.

quotes: email+Password authentication is not yet implemented. Please use Internet Identity to sign in....this message coming so implement
admin email is jogoshree@gmail.com and password is Admin@123

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an Email+Password login API that accepts an email and password and returns a successful result when credentials are valid, and a failure result when credentials are invalid.

On successful credential login, the backend associates the caller Principal with the authenticated email identity for subsequent role checks/queries in this app session (as defined by the backend API contract).

If the authenticated email matches the configured bootstrap admin email (case-insensitive, trimmed), the backend assigns the Admin role to the caller principal (or confirms Admin role already assigned).
The seeded admin credentials use email "jogoshree@gmail.com" and password "Admin@123" exactly (resolve any mismatch with prior seeded password values so this login works).

requirements.text: Implement backend OTP authentication APIs in the single Motoko actor to request an OTP for an email or mobile identifier and to verify the OTP to authenticate the caller.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an OTP request API that accepts an email or mobile identifier and creates an OTP challenge with a limited validity window.
Backend exposes an OTP verify API that accepts the identifier + OTP code and returns success only for the correct, unexpired OTP.

On successful OTP verification, the backend associates the caller Principal with the authenticated identifier for subsequent role checks/queries in this app session (as defined by the backend API contract).
The OTP flow works without any external SMS/email provider integrations (no Twilio/SendGrid/etc.).

requirements.text: Update the unified frontend Login page to remove placeholder/toast-only behavior for Email+Password and OTP tabs and wire both flows to the new backend APIs, using clear English user-facing messages for success and failure states.

quotes: email+Password authentication is not yet implemented. Please use Internet Identity to sign in....this message coming so implement

acceptanceCriteria: The Email+Password tab no longer shows the 'under development' warning messaging and no longer toasts 'not yet implemented' on submit; instead it calls the backend and shows an error message only when authentication fails.

The OTP tab no longer shows the 'under development' warning messaging and no longer toasts 'not yet available' on submit; instead it supports (1) requesting an OTP and (2) verifying it via backend calls.

After successful Email+Password or OTP login, the app redirects Admin users to /admin and non-admin users to / (no navigation during render; redirects happen via effects or router actions already used elsewhere).
All user-facing text related to these flows is in English and does not mention 'Coming soon'/'not implemented' for features that are implemented by this change.

requirements.text: Ensure Admin routing behavior matches requirements across all supported login methods: after successful login, if the caller role is Admin then route to the Admin panel (/admin); otherwise route to the customer homepage (/).

quotes: admin redirect to admin panel as i said before

acceptanceCriteria: After Internet Identity login, authenticated Admin users are redirected to /admin; non-admin users are redirected to /.
After Email+Password login, authenticated Admin users are redirected to /admin; non-admin users are redirected to /.
After OTP login, authenticated Admin users are redirected to /admin; non-admin users are redirected to /.

requirements.text: Run a focused full build pass (frontend + backend) and fix any compile/runtime blockers introduced or revealed by implementing Email+Password + OTP auth, keeping changes minimal and stability-focused.
acceptanceCriteria: Motoko canister compiles successfully with the new auth APIs.
Frontend builds without TypeScript errors and the /login page loads without runtime crashes.
Logging in via Email+Password and OTP can be exercised end-to-end from the /login page without hitting placeholder toasts or unimplemented code paths.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths (compose existing components instead).
No third-party authentication providers beyond existing Internet Identity; no Google OAuth.
No external SMS/email delivery integrations for OTP (must function without Twilio/SendGrid/SMTP/Webhooks).
nonGoals: Implementing real OTP delivery via SMS/Email/WhatsApp providers.
Implementing password reset flows beyond basic login.
Adding new admin/staff role management features beyond what is needed to authenticate and route correctly.
